reason: The README describes a plugin for browsing, searching, and citing a local Zotero library through a sidebar and input shortcuts, with read-only SQLite access and citation resolution.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过侧边栏浏览和搜索本地 Zotero 文献库，并将所选文献引用插入输入框。
summaries.en: Browse and search a local Zotero library in a DeepSeek Harness sidebar, then insert selected literature references into the input field.

capabilities: Reads the local Zotero SQLite database
Displays Zotero collections and items in a sidebar
Inserts citation reference tokens into the input field
Resolves citation tokens to bibliographic metadata for model use
Opens Zotero deep links on the local machine
